limits: Custom native-resolution stress tests, not CIFAR-C. All 15 preset conditions retained. For the aggregate, average conditions within each seed/source image before resampling; conditions are fixed, not independent replicates. Unadjusted descriptive intervals condition on the fixed bank, head, selected generators, one fixed corruption field and MC8 draws. Differences against separately trained controls do not isolate an inference-only sigma effect.
